# Integrate Medical Knowledge

The calls themselves: where they live, what they need in their headers, every operation, and one request written out in full.

## Hosts

- `https://api.eka.care` Production
- `https://api.dev.eka.care` Stage/Sandbox

## Auth and headers

Get a token first: [Authentication](https://developer.eka.care/api-sdk/auth/getting-started).

- `BearerAuth`: HTTP bearer. Send `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

## Read first

- [Datasets API](https://developer.eka.care/api-sdk/datasets/overview)
- [Medications](https://developer.eka.care/api-sdk/datasets/medications)
- [Lab investigations](https://developer.eka.care/api-sdk/datasets/lab-investigations)
- [Lab results](https://developer.eka.care/api-sdk/datasets/lab-results)
- [Lab panels](https://developer.eka.care/api-sdk/datasets/lab-panels)
- [Symptoms](https://developer.eka.care/api-sdk/datasets/symptoms)
- [Diagnoses](https://developer.eka.care/api-sdk/datasets/diagnoses)

## Endpoints

14 operations, grouped by tag.

### datasets

| Method | Path | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `GET` | [`/admin/datasets/v1/`](https://developer.eka.care/api-sdk/datasets/list) | List dataset records |
| `POST` | [`/admin/datasets/v1/`](https://developer.eka.care/api-sdk/datasets/write) | Create or update records |
| `GET` | [`/admin/datasets/v1/batches/`](https://developer.eka.care/api-sdk/datasets/batches) | List CSV import batches |
| `POST` | [`/admin/datasets/v1/delete-all/`](https://developer.eka.care/api-sdk/datasets/delete-all) | Delete the whole catalog |
| `POST` | [`/admin/datasets/v1/delete/`](https://developer.eka.care/api-sdk/datasets/delete) | Deactivate records |
| `GET` | [`/admin/datasets/v1/export.csv`](https://developer.eka.care/api-sdk/datasets/export) | Export the catalog as CSV |
| `GET` | [`/admin/datasets/v1/search-status/`](https://developer.eka.care/api-sdk/datasets/search-status-get) | Get partner search status |
| `POST` | [`/admin/datasets/v1/search-status/`](https://developer.eka.care/api-sdk/datasets/search-status-set) | Turn partner search on or off |
| `GET` | [`/admin/datasets/v1/{entity_id}/`](https://developer.eka.care/api-sdk/datasets/get) | Get a record |

## One request in full

POST /admin/datasets/v1/, from [its page](https://developer.eka.care/api-sdk/datasets/write).

```bash
curl -X POST 'https://api.eka.care/admin/datasets/v1/' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '[
  {
    "medication_id": "DRUG1001",
    "name": "Dolo 650",
    "strength": "650mg",
    "generic_name": "Paracetamol",
    "form_name": "Tablet",
    "manufacturer": "Micro Labs Ltd"
  },
  {
    "medication_id": "DRUG1002",
    "name": "Augmentin 625 Duo",
    "generic_list": [
      "Amoxicillin",
      "Clavulanic Acid"
    ],
    "form_name": "Tablet"
  }
]'
```
